nodes.text: Hollow outline. The resting shape everything else is measured against.
A segment travels the edge. Motion reads at 16px where a colour shift doesn't.
Filled centre — the only state that adds mass, so it's noticeable without being alarming.
Dashed and dimmed — the outline is interrupted, which is exactly what's happening.
Struck through. Nothing is syncing and nothing is lost — it's waiting.
Every state is distinguishable in one colour, at 16px, on a light or dark panel. Colour repeats the message for people who can use it.
